caption: The drawing features a floral design on a beige or off-white rectangular background, with a slightly lighter rectangle in the center of the composition. The design itself consists of three stylized flowers placed horizontally across the middle. Each flower has five rounded petals colored in pink with a blue dot at the center. From each flower extend wavy, light brown leaves and three-pronged, scalloped shapes, also in light brown, attached via thin blue stems. Additional blue curved lines travel through the leaves and connect the flower motifs. The overall design is symmetrical, with the central flower being larger and having a distinctive blue, scalloped lower edge. At the bottom left corner, the handwritten text reads: "DETAIL DE PORFIRR. COLCHA #4 CLARLFIN – THOS."
title: Colcha
